== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Mercenary Shadow Pirate (Errata)]] (<code>1263_6</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 3•06), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-06-Mercenary_Shadow_Pirate.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-mercenaryshadowpirate-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Mercenary Shadow Pirate]]. The Master List slip prints this text without card art.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, Dark Side (p. 12), official text as of 27 April 2013 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]]; original http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “[Pilot] 2. Opponent may not add destiny draws to power or attrition here. Sandwhirl and Ice Storm are canceled at same and related locations.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1263_6</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 3•06 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-06-Mercenary_Shadow_Pirate-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B10 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
